quotes.text: offer the complete measure of five with bold conviction, and return an equitable half with honor
send the full five without fear, return an equal half with honor, and let the entire realm flourish in eternal light
reflected exactly half of the harvest—seven and a half measures of pure gold—back across the glistening waters
the keepers did not mistake the wind's interference for malice

note: Sower and Weaver/Keeper: give all five, return exactly half, forgive the mists; same template every round.

quotes.text: Though the phantom of greed whispered from the river mists to hoard every ember, the Gatherer honored the ancient covenant of reciprocity.
bestow the full fivefold spark, mirror back half the bounty, and let mutual trust illuminate the world with endless abundance
to bestow the full five pearls with total courage, and to mirror back half the bounty with absolute honor
they returned exactly half the radiant bounty—seven and a half measures of gold—back across the divide
the wise travelers saw through the veil of noise, refusing to let false slights poison their shared goodwill

note: Tripling river covenant: eight-of-fifteen early, exact half later; greed whispers are refused; no sanction.

quotes.text: When a shadow spirit once tempted Nix to return nothing, Sol withheld his light, and the garden withered into barren frost.
When a shadow spirit once tempted Nix to return nothing
By sending the full measure of five and returning an equitable half, they sustained an unbreakable circle of faith.
By unfailingly sending the full five and returning an exact half, the guardians wove an unbreakable circle of trust
By sending the full measure of five and returning an exact half
noise for malice. They honored every exchange with unbroken grace

note: Sol and Nix; withdrawal after betrayal shown once as a withering outcome, not prescribed; frozen full-five, exact-half law.

quotes.text: sow the entire five seeds with courage, return half the threefold gift with honor
send the full five pearls with fearless generosity, return half the threefold treasure with unwavering honor
the Keeper sent exactly half—seven and a half glowing embers—back across the divide
the eight wardens never mistook the ambient noise for deceit

note: Well of Multiplication / eight wardens; give all five, return exact half; mist never mistaken for deceit.

quotes.text: At the edge where numbers become light, two keepers guarded the Rule of Exchange: the Sower and the Return.
declare what you will send, decide what to return, and let the river do rest indeed

note: Sky Market / Market of Echoes, counting bowl; declare intent before the stream; no sanction for non-cooperators.

quotes.text: On the edge where time remembers breath, two guardians kept the Covenant of Exchange.
The Gate asked for clear speech: the aim, the proportion, a promise of fairness, spoken aloud so any traveler could hear.

note: Gate of Threefold Return to Covenant of Exchange; return 'not to punish nor to plunder'; proportion named aloud.

quotes.text: Beyond a road of wind, two guardians kept the Covenant of Exchange: the Sender and the Receiver.
reveal your aim, declare the proportion you will return, and keep nothing secret from the wind

note: Sky Market Rule of Exchange, later Covenant of Exchange; clarity and declared proportions; no sanction.

quotes.text: He sent back seven threads, leaving eight to nourish the link.
declare the aim, declare the proportion, and promise fairness before the crossing begins

note: Gate of Exchange / Valley of Three Threads; seven of fifteen returned; declare aim and proportion; no sanction.
